design.1-evidence: New default-on mode. --no-evidence is the explicit opt-out and prints one notice line to stderr. Checks, in order, per unit: (a) every non-null stageReceipts.<stage> with a path must resolve to an existing file under the roadmap directory, failing as '<unit>.stageReceipts.<stage> path does not exist: <path>'; (b) for product-class units only, the mainProof receipt's runtime.playwright must parse as one of three forms - '<label>: N failed / M passed', '<label>: N passed (...)' (label optional, so U1's bare total parses), or '<label>: Tests: N passed, M total' - failing as '<unit> mainProof runtime.playwright is not a ladder or jest result: <verbatim>'; (c) when the parse reports N failed > 0, the receipt must carry expectedReds (top level, else under runtime) as an array of N non-empty strings, failing on absence, on a non-array, on a length mismatch against N, and on a non-string entry.
design.2-github: Opt-in --github. For every unit whose reviewClasses intersect the sensitive set and whose STATE_RANK is >= merged, take the PR number from the merge receipt (stageReceipts.merge.pr, else the merge receipt file's pr) and run `gh pr view <pr> --json state,labels,comments`. Fail unless state === 'MERGED', labels contains 'owner-ruled', and some comment body contains 'OWNER-RULING <mergeHead>' with the exact 40-hex stageReceipts.merge.head. When gh is absent or the call fails, print a one-line notice and fail - never a silent pass. On this baseline the only such unit is U3 (PR #1797, head 935fe0423e9eef2c806ab8b4e012c9a9a8d6c929).
design.3-pathFree: In the --next selection, replace the exact-string membership test with directory-boundary prefix containment: a candidate path conflicts with an in-flight path when the two are equal, or one is a prefix of the other followed by '/'. 'src/lib' therefore blocks 'src/lib/multiplayer/server' and vice versa, while 'src/libx' stays unrelated.
design.4-test: New openspec/planning/2026-09-12-roadmap-completion/validate-roadmap.test.mjs, runnable with `node --test`, no jest and no package.json script. Each case materialises a fixture ledger in a fresh os.tmpdir() directory (roadmap.json and units.json rewritten down to the few units the case needs, evidence/admission-snapshot.json and DELIVERY.md copied, only the receipts the fixture names) and runs the validator as a child process with --roadmap pointing at the fixture.
